newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle quiet, bid $115/dressed - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle quiet, bid $115/dressed - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets were quiet amid light packer inquiry at $115.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, steady with the bulk of last week's sales, according to market sources.

There was a top late last week of $116.00, which was encouraging asking levels of $118.00 to $120.00, they said. On a live basis, asking levels were quoted at $74.00-$75.00, with no bids or sales reported.
This week's showlist was estimated at 65,000 head, up 8,000 from last week. Some of the increase was tied to unfinished cattle carried over from last week.
